intro: Trying to find California scholarships for high school applicants with financial need usually means sorting through very different rules, award sizes, and deadline windows. This filtered USA view brings those listings into one place so you can compare options that match this specific mix of need-based, high school, and California criteria. The programs below span themes like education, community, STEM, medicine, and disability, and some may fit high school seniors while others can include earlier high school stages or related applicant types. Awards vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirement details are not identical across these rows, so it is worth reading each entry closely before you apply.
